title: Scroll edges and fling
question: Fast trackpad flick: rows stay filled and complete, the list now moves together with its rows. Keep? Rec: keep, after a check on the Mac.
check:
- Same 10,000 px/s flick over 10k tracks, half speed, headless Chromium
- Old: rows lose waveform, BPM and key while moving, edges go empty
- New: every row complete in every frame
- On the Mac the list ends no longer rubber-band

history.question: Scrolling: rows at the edges no longer blank, waveforms catch up after a fling. Good?
history.check:
- Fast flick at 50k, half speed: old shows empty rows at the bottom edge for a few frames
- New: the edge stays filled; row waveforms are empty while flinging and draw when it slows
- Slow scrolling looks the same as before
